Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2, crisp voxel style, vanilla Minecraft blocks only, plain light background, no characters or animals. Two views side by side: LEFT straight-on front elevation orthographic; RIGHT three-quarter view at the same scale, showing the front, side, roof and deep rear garden. Skilled human builder quality: real massing and depth, projecting details, recessed framed openings, real roof verges/eaves/ridge, stairs/slabs/fences/walls/trapdoors/lantern details. Both views depict the same build.
Site: San Francisco Italianate painted lady on a steep city street rising to the right, wedged between an ochre house downhill LEFT and taller pale-blue house uphill RIGHT. Lot 16 blocks wide and 50 deep; main house 14x26, garage base plus three storeys, about 20 blocks tall. Above a dark sea-green garage base with burgundy garage door, a slim three-storey teal wooden front rises in horizontal siding. LEFT half is a full-height angled bay projecting over driveway on cream corbels. Bay corners have cream pilasters; every storey tall narrow sash windows with cream sills and hoods. RIGHT cream-trimmed stone stair with lantern newel posts climbs to recessed porch with two slender cream columns and burgundy double door with transom. Above porch pairs of tall windows under small cream pediments. Two gold fish-scale shingle bands wrap front and bay at floor lines, represented by stepped vanilla bamboo mosaic slabs/stairs. Burgundy frieze with paired cream brackets supports deep cream cornice. False-front parapet with gold fish-scale panels and small cream pediment hides low dark-slate gable roof with iron crest and two brick chimneys. Tiny flower garden behind black iron fence beside stair; street lamp at curb. Behind house spruce deck steps down from kitchen French doors into deep garden, flowering tree, vegetable bed, wooden side fences. Keep neighbors partial so main house and garden are legible. No interior cutaway or invented furnishings.
